label: FSL fslreorient2std
description:
Reorient an image to standard label orientation; this is not registration.

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

input_slots.label: input
input_slots.description: Input image. Choose an existing file; the command never modifies it.

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Reorient an image to standard label orientation; this is not registration. The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.

omitted_options.other_options: Only the documented options below are exposed. Consult the installed-version help for other syntax; arbitrary arguments are not accepted.
